title: Bible extractor: priorBible + closedArcSummaries input + no-omit prompt (06b.1-A)
description:
Update `packages/core/src/memory/campaignBibleExtractor.ts` so that callers can feed the prior bible and closed-arc summaries into the extraction call, and so the system prompt instructs the model not to silently drop entries.

Parent: loreweaver-06b.1 (Strengthen campaign bible faithfulness). This is the pure-core change with deterministic tests; CLI wiring (06b.1-B) and the gated live-API faithfulness test (06b.1-C) build on top of it.

Scope:
- Extend `ExtractCampaignBibleInput` with optional `priorBible?: CampaignBibleInput` and `closedArcSummaries?: ArcSummaryRecord[]`.
- Append two instructions to `BIBLE_EXTRACTOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT`: (1) treat `## previously known bible` entries as canonical unless the recaps explicitly contradict/retire them; (2) only drop an entry if the recaps contradict it or it was an error — going off-screen is not a reason.
- Render a `## previously known bible` block (with `### worldFacts/majorNpcs/factions/openThreads` subsections) when `priorBible` is provided and non-empty.
- Render a `## closed arc summaries` block before the recap list when `closedArcSummaries` is provided and non-empty; preserve input order.
- When both are absent or empty, the rendered user message must be byte-identical to today's recap-only layout (regression-safe for pre-x63 callers).
- Output schema (`CampaignBibleInput`) and the fenced `bible_json` contract are unchanged.
design:
- Add two helper renderers — `renderPriorBible` and `renderClosedArcSummaries` — that return either the rendered block or the empty string, so the call site can join with `

` and elide absent sections without conditionals leaking into `renderRecaps`.
- System prompt update is two extra bullet lines appended to the existing array; same join('
') idiom.
- Tests: add cases to `packages/core/test/campaignBibleExtractor.test.ts` — (a) prior bible round-trips into user content, (b) closed arc summaries appear in order, (c) absent fields fall through to the legacy layout (snapshot the captured `messages[0].content` and compare to a literal), (d) system prompt contains the no-omit phrase.
acceptance_criteria:
- `extractCampaignBible` accepts optional `priorBible` and `closedArcSummaries` without breaking existing callers.
- System prompt contains the no-omit instruction (assertable via substring match in a test).
- User content includes the `## previously known bible` block with all four lists when `priorBible` is populated.
- User content includes a `## closed arc summaries` block in input order when `closedArcSummaries` is populated.
- When both are absent the user content is identical to today's recap-only output.
- `npm run typecheck` passes; `npm run test` passes (new deterministic tests included).
notes: PR #63 opened against main with 7 new deterministic tests + 6 existing tests all passing. Full suite: 456 passed, 2 skipped (documented gated tests), 0 failed. Awaiting review.
